title: Conditional good models for strongly Q-factorial Kähler fourfolds
exact_target: Assume full orbifold Iitaka subadditivity in Fujiki class C, the stated pseudo-effective klt fourfold MMP conditional on it, and abundance for nef klt fourfold adjoints after nonvanishing. For a normal connected globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold X with effective rational klt boundary B and Q-Cartier analytically pseudo-effective $K_X+B$, must there be a bimeromorphic good minimal model extracting no divisor, improving discrepancies strictly on contracted primes and having a globally generated positive Cartier adjoint multiple?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
Assume full orbifold Iitaka subadditivity in Fujiki class C, the stated pseudo-effective klt fourfold MMP conditional on it, and abundance for nef klt fourfold adjoints after nonvanishing. For a normal connected globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold X with effective rational klt boundary B and Q-Cartier analytically pseudo-effective $K_X+B$, must there be a bimeromorphic good minimal model extracting no divisor, improving discrepancies strictly on contracted primes and having a globally generated positive Cartier adjoint multiple?

\subsection{Short English statement}
Assume full orbifold Iitaka subadditivity in Fujiki class C, the stated pseudo-effective klt fourfold MMP conditional on it, and abundance for nef klt fourfold adjoints after nonvanishing. For a normal connected globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold X with effective rational klt boundary B and Q-Cartier analytically pseudo-effective $K_X+B$, must there be a bimeromorphic good minimal model extracting no divisor, improving discrepancies strictly on contracted primes and having a globally generated positive Cartier adjoint multiple?
